message.content: {"thought": "The materialized candidate increases compute_units from 4096 to 16384 on all 16 WS chiplets, with macs automatically updated to [8,8,16,16]. This directly addresses the compute-bound FFN1 tilings. The expected benefit: FFN1 latency reduces ~4x (from ~14.5B to ~3.6B per tiling), critical path latency reduces from ~29.1B to ~18.2B, and compute energy reduces proportionally. Although monetary cost will increase (compute cost is 49.3% of total), the latency and energy reductions are substantial enough to plausibly compensate. This is a legal, simulator-evaluable parameter update. I have sufficient evidence to finish and propose this as the next hardware configuration.", "action": "finish", "finish_reason": "Sufficient evidence gathered: bottleneck is purely compute-bound FFN1 tilings with 4096 compute units per WS chiplet. Increasing compute_units to 16384 on all 16 chiplets directly reduces FFN1 latency by ~4x, reducing critical path latency from ~29.1B to ~18.2B and compute energy proportionally. The monetary cost increase is justified by the substantial latency-energy improvement. The candidate has been materialized and is ready for evaluation."}
